method: Manual check of all 20 probe answers against memory_probes.yaml. Truth: user = Pinal, San Jose; user allergic to peanuts, son Arjun allergic to eggs; shops at Safeway on Saturday (Costco is the neighbour's store); has spinach, frozen blueberries and a cantaloupe at home; returned deli turkey because of a Listeria recall. Rule: start from the automatic keyword score; subtract 1 for each wrong or invented minor detail; subtract 2 for a wrong safety-critical fact (allergy given to the wrong person); minimum 1. The automatic score only checks that key words appear, so it cannot see wrong attributions or invented details.
